verdict.rationale: Plaid's Identity product retrieves the information on file with the user's financial institution. That covers name, mailing address, phone number and email address, which is exactly the account-holder data needed to match the owner against a customer record. Evidence comes only from brief first-party doc snippets. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on per-account or multiple-owner coverage, and documented built-in matching or scoring against customer records.
